variables: Audio waveform bar height, loudest; also the waveform row height.
Translucent fill behind controls on a video (the play button), the same for receiver and sender in both modes.
Icons on video controls, the same for receiver and sender in both modes.
Size of the logomark slot in an lg Logo (40), the same as the wordmark height.
Size of the logomark slot in an sm Logo (24), the same as the wordmark height.
Length of the fade at a scroll edge in compact scroll areas such as Menu (16).
Length of the fade at a scroll edge in larger scroll areas such as Sidebar and Code snippet (32).
Scrollbar thumb. Shown on every scroll area that overflows, together with the fade.
Surface/surface-100 at 0% opacity: the transparent end of the scroll fade on that surface. Points at the same primitive in each mode, so the fade blends without a tint.
Menu/surface-rest at 0% opacity: the transparent end of the scroll fade on that surface. Points at the same primitive in each mode, so the fade blends without a tint.
Date/Calendar/surface at 0% opacity: the transparent end of the scroll fade on that surface. Points at the same primitive in each mode, so the fade blends without a tint.
TextInput/surface-rest at 0% opacity: the transparent end of the scroll fade on that surface. Points at the same primitive in each mode, so the fade blends without a tint.
TextInput/surface-hover at 0% opacity: the transparent end of the scroll fade on that surface. Points at the same primitive in each mode, so the fade blends without a tint.
Letter spacing for every text style (0). The only step for now; add tighter or wider steps here if a style ever needs them.
Press feedback on buttons and other pressable elements. 160ms.
Modals. 250ms. UI motion stays at or under this unless it uses xl or 2xl.
Default curve. Anything entering or exiting. cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1).
Elements moving or morphing while on screen. cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1).
Sidebar and sheet slides, paired with duration/2xl. cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1).
Reserved for Toast enter and exit. 400ms. Deliberately above the 250ms UI limit.
Reserved for Sidebar and sheet slides, paired with easing/drawer. 500ms. Deliberately above the 250ms UI limit.
Hover and color changes. Same as the CSS ease keyword: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1).
Constant motion only: progress fills and hold-to-confirm. Never for entering or exiting UI. linear.
Large phones in landscape and small tablets. min-width 640. Bland has no template at this width.
Tablet layout starts. min-width 768. Matches the tablet 768 x 1024 template.
Large tablets and small laptops. min-width 1024. Matches the tablet 1024 x 1366 template.
Desktop layout starts. min-width 1280. Matches the desktop 1280 x 832 template.
Wide desktop. min-width 1536. Matches the desktop 1536 x 864 template; the page grid widens to Desktop/md here.
One full turn of a loading spinner, repeated while loading. 800ms, paired with easing/linear. Continuous motion only, not for entering or exiting UI.

How long a Toast stays on screen before it dismisses itself (5s). Not an animation: the Toaster in code reads it, and pauses it while the pointer is over the stack, focus is inside it or the page is hidden. Its exit then runs at duration/xl.

How long the pointer rests on a trigger before its Tooltip opens (500ms). Not an animation: Tooltip in code reads it as its hover delay. Keyboard focus opens a tooltip at once, and once one tooltip is open the next opens without the delay. The tooltip then shows at duration/xs.

How long a Tooltip stays after the pointer leaves its trigger (100ms), so the pointer can cross onto the tooltip without it closing. Not an animation: Tooltip in code reads it as its close delay. Escape, blur and a press close it at once.
Gap between the tip of the Tooltip pointer and its trigger. Code adds it to tooltip/pointer-depth as the distance from the trigger edge to the tooltip box.
Neutral source color at 60% opacity. Follows the source color. Used by the Modal backdrop in dark.
Modal backdrop, minimal dim: the page stays readable behind the dialog. Neutral at 10% in light, 24% in dark. Code: the Modal backdrop prop, minimal.
Modal backdrop, subtle dim: the default behind every Modal. Neutral at 24% in light, 40% in dark. Code: the Modal backdrop prop, subtle (default).
Modal backdrop, bold dim: the page recedes, for a decision that needs full attention. Neutral at 40% in light, 60% in dark. Code: the Modal backdrop prop, bold.
Fill of the calendar title toggle, the month and year button that switches views. In code: --date-calendar-title-bar-surface.
Divider between file details on the receiver bubble (file type | size). Softer than receiver-content-subtle so it does not pull attention from the text on either side.
Divider between file details on the sender bubble (file type | size). Softer than sender-content-subtle so it does not pull attention from the text on either side.
One cycle of the typing indicator: the three dots of a typing Chat bubble lift and brighten in turn, then repeat (a loop, not a one-off animation). Code: duration/typing.

How long the pointer rests on a minimized Sidebar before it opens over the page. Moving restarts the wait, so passing over the rail never opens it. A delay, not an animation. Code: the Sidebar peekDelay prop defaults to it.
How long an open minimized Sidebar waits after the pointer leaves before it closes, so a brief exit does not close it. A delay, not an animation. Code: the Sidebar peekCloseDelay prop defaults to it.

How long a scrollbar stays after scrolling stops before it fades out (1s, the macOS overlay scrollbar standard). Scrollbars show only while an area scrolls or its thumb is held. A delay, not an animation: ScrollArea in code reads it; the thumb then fades at duration/md.

How long a copy button shows its Check and says Copied after a copy (2s, the common standard), whether or not the pointer stays on it. Not an animation: Code snippet and Code text read it in code, then the Copy icon comes back.
Chat list item fill for the open chat (code: aria-current). Same tint as Sidebar/surface-selected.
Chat list item fill for the open chat on hover.
Tallest the message bar field grows as lines are typed (about six lines); past it the field scrolls.
Page grid columns on mobile layouts (4), below breakpoint/md. Code: .bland-grid (docs/grid.md).
Page grid columns on tablet layouts (6), from breakpoint/md. Code: .bland-grid (docs/grid.md).
Page grid columns on desktop layouts (8), from breakpoint/xl. Code: .bland-grid (docs/grid.md).
Widest the page grid gets from breakpoint/xl (1136: eight 128 columns and seven 16 gutters, Desktop/sm). Wider screens centre it. Code: .bland-grid (docs/grid.md).
Large desktop. min-width 1920. Matches the desktop 1920 x 1080 template; the page grid widens to Desktop/lg here.
Widest the page grid gets from breakpoint/2xl (1264: eight 144 columns and seven 16 gutters, Desktop/md). Wider screens centre it. Code: .bland-grid (docs/grid.md).
Widest the page grid gets from breakpoint/3xl (1392: eight 160 columns and seven 16 gutters, Desktop/lg). Wider screens centre it. Code: .bland-grid (docs/grid.md).

The typeface for headings: every Display, Heading and Title text style. Points at family/body, so one font sets both; set its own family for a separate heading font. In code: --font-heading, which a project can override (docs/brand.md, Fonts).

A card or panel that sits on surface-sunken: white in light, one step lighter than the page in dark, so it reads as on top in both modes (the numbered surfaces mirror between modes and cannot do this). For project layouts; no Bland component uses it.
Hover on surface-raised, for a card that can be clicked: one step darker in light, one step lighter in dark.

A layer behind the content: a gray app background under surface-raised cards, a demo stage, a well. Gray in light and the page color in dark, so it stays behind in both modes; a border marks it where it meets surface-100. For project layouts; no Bland component uses it.
